description: List the index (Register) of the document: index_exists, topics[] in tree order {path, level, name, sort_as, page_reference_count, cross_reference_count, page_references[] {page_reference_id, type, page_id, page_name, frame_id, story_id, index, in_overset}, cross_references[] {cross_reference_id, type, topic (path), custom_text}}, topic_count, page_reference_count, cross_reference_count and index_stories[] {story_id, frame_ids, page_ids, page_names, paragraph_count, length, overset} – generated indexes in the document. topic_contains filters by any level (case-insensitive; sub-topics of a match are only listed if they match too); include_references false leaves out the reference lists. Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_references.description: List page and cross references per topic (default true).

topic_contains.description: Only topics whose path contains this text.

name: list_index
title: List index topics
